top_signals.title: India’s Oil Imports Hit Record High as Saudi Shipments Surge
top_signals.summary: India imported a record-high level of crude oil volumes in October, trade data showed on Thursday, as volumes from Saudi Arabia jumped to an eight-month high amid a recovery in Gulf shipments. India imported a record 5.58 million barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil last month, up by 4.7% compared to September and a 6.9% rise from October 2025, according to the trade data cited by Reuters.  Russia remained the single largest oil supplier to India, with Indian imports rising by 3.5% in October compared to September.
